history.summary: Large 850sqft '1BR' at Pebble Bay, D15 Tanjong Rhu, at $1.59M / $1,871 PSF — note the size suggests this is really a generous 1+study or mislabelled larger unit. Strong 4.7%/yr resale CAGR on a deep 103-transaction series and 270m to the new Tanjong Rhu TEL station are the standout positives.
history.rating_rationale: This is the data-richest entry in the batch: 4.67%/yr resale-only CAGR on 103 URA transactions (high confidence) and PSF ($1,871) only ~1% over the $1,846 median. 99yr leasehold from 1998 (~71yrs left) is the main drag, but 270m to the brand-new TE23 Tanjong Rhu MRT is a concrete catalyst in the Greater Southern Waterfront orbit. The 850sqft size for a '1BR' means real living space and broad resale appeal, not a shoebox. Genuine value at $1.59M.
red_flags: 99yr leasehold from 1998 — ~71 years remaining, lease decay will weigh over a 5-7yr hold
Unusual 850sqft for a '1BR' — verify actual layout/bedroom count
catalysts: 270m to new TE23 Tanjong Rhu MRT (Thomson-East Coast Line)
Greater Southern Waterfront / Kallang Riverside transformation nearby
Deep 103-txn liquidity with proven 4.7%/yr resale appreciation

history.summary: 2,626sqft 4BR at $5.25M / $1,999psf re-judged under v3.4.1+ priors. Same-size comps (Sep 2025: 2,626sqft $5.75M @ $2,189psf; Dec 2025: 2,626sqft $4.90M @ $1,865psf) put the ask squarely at the same-size cohort mean (~$2,027psf) — no cheap-vs-peers edge once the pooled-median illusion is removed. Only validated positive is the RCR region baseline. Against that: ~67yr remaining lease crosses the ~60yr CPF/financing threshold during the 5-7yr hold (next buyer pool structurally shrinks at exit), and $5M+ Tanjong Rhu liquidity is thin (only 2 of 13 Pebble Bay prints in 12mo were >=$5M). The 4.67%/yr trailing CAGR that led the prior Buy is a ~0-forward-power signal and is stripped; operational TEL is priced in.
history.rating_rationale: Fairly priced vs same-size comps (no value edge); ~67yr lease hits the 60yr CPF/LTV threshold exactly at the exit window; $5.25M quantum has a verified-thin exit pool (2 prints/yr >=$5M); only remaining validated positive is the RCR baseline — net negative for a 5-7yr investment hold.
red_flags: ~67yr remaining lease (99yr from ~1994) crosses the ~60yr CPF/financing threshold at exit in year 5-7 — structural buyer-pool shrinkage exactly when selling
$5.25M top-decile quantum: only 2 of ~13 Pebble Bay prints in the last 12 months were >=$5M — thin exit pool is real, not an algo artifact
No same-size value edge: ask $1,999psf sits between the two 2,626sqft prints ($1,865 and $2,189psf) — the apparent pooled-median premium/discount is size-mix noise
Prior Buy rationale (4.67%/yr trailing CAGR on 103 txns) is a ~0-forward-power signal under backtested priors
1998 build — aging facilities/maintenance for a luxury-quantum buyer
catalysts: D15 RCR baseline (realized fwd ~+3.1-3.7%/yr) — only backtest-validated positive
Tanjong Rhu GLS awarded $709M ($1,455 psf ppr) — new-launch benchmark uplift narrative, but weak spillover to a 28yr-old 67yr-lease large unit
270m to operational Tanjong Rhu TEL (TE23) — already priced in
history.source: re-eval under v3.4.1+ priors (2026-06-11 loop iter 15; supersedes 2026-06-08 pre-prior-fix Buy)
